strengths_deep_dive: Baitulmaal shows strong organizational transparency, backed by a <cite id="1">99/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> and a Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid. Operationally, the charity maintains efficient spending, needing only <cite id="1">$0.10 per $1 raised</cite> in donations. In FY2024, total revenue grew significantly, driven by large-scale relief operations. For faith-based givers, the organization provides <cite id="4">zakat calculation tools</cite> and aligns direct aid with eligible categories like fuqara and masakin.
rich_narrative.summary: In FY2024, Baitulmaal generated <cite id="3">$77,434,379 in total revenue</cite> to support international humanitarian relief, disaster response, and orphan care across regions like Gaza, Yemen, and Kenya. The organization maintains a <cite id="1">99/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting solid operational transparency and strong organizational governance. While the organization reports a <cite id="1">77.4% program expense ratio</cite>, its cash-adjusted program ratio sits at 77% due to a heavy reliance on non-cash in-kind donations. Despite this accounting nuance, the 77% cash-adjusted ratio exceeds the 75% industry benchmark, demonstrating good spending alignment toward direct service delivery.
